name: garage:VAMP
source:
You may not live the most glamorous life- but you've got your own place, a loving wife, and a stable job. What more could you ask for?

Yet, this peaceful life is about to get a lot more complicated thanks to the presence of a certain supernatural stowaway. You see- you've got a vampire in your garage and he only has one thing on his mind- your wife.

As the days unfold, so too does this debauched drama. Each day brings new temptations, delights, and a step further into corruption. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1862660/]Steam[/url]]
